gaps: No mapped dedicated deterministic unit suite for these acceptance entry points. Underlying engine/provider tests do not certify the operator scripts or external acceptance; inspect their explicit local/read-only boundaries before use.

Live Privy is unverified: the suites verify real ES256 access tokens with the official @privy-io/node SDK against a local key, and the browser suite uses the MOCKED loopback Privy stand-in (e2e/privy-emulator.ts). They certify FloFi's verification, linking, isolation and signing-gate rules, not Privy itself; docs/deploy/LIVE-VERIFICATION-PRIVY.md is the owner's live check.

Privy's embedded wallet trusts the whole product origin. All product-origin HTML, including public, admin and error pages, carries a nonce script policy; the signer additionally mounts only in a document loaded with its route's policy class. This mitigates injected script but is not a cryptographic restriction on trusted page code or browser extensions. Live Privy and owner device acceptance remain separate.

Legacy FloFi Wallet (Turnkey) is export-only; its unlock and export remain covered by the wallet-app and wallet-relay suites with the in-process provider stand-in. Current hosted reliance is unverified.

Completed executions by channel (KAN-25) are verified against seeded handoff, workflow-run, run and origin records, not production data. With migration 0037 an origin is recorded when an execution is created (approval requester; on /app Web Chat only with the Chat's server-verified, account-bound initiation reference, else Web Editor; an approval page's own approval; or an approval binding); a web record at creation yields to a contradicting approval binding. The Chat reference proves the server issued it to that account recently and the browser presented it, not which control a person pressed; Chat executions without a FloFi account session are recorded as Web Editor. History before 0037 is recovered only by the audited, owner-run origin-backfill command (Legacy Web only where the approval history proves no approval page created the run); the production backfill has not been run.

Email goes out through Resend from the Railway worker (FLOFI_FLIGHT_EMAIL=enabled); tests use a fake provider in the test process, so delivery, spam placement, DNS (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) and the account's real quota are not proven by tests. The FloFi quota counts FloFi's own reservations only (sends outside FloFi need the external reserve and reconciliation in the Resend dashboard). No bounce or complaint webhook is consumed. Joining has no confirmation step (any address can be submitted); campaign access needs a proven address (Privy-verified login email, or the access link or code). X handles are self-declared. Production rate and abuse behaviour is not measured by tests; browser funnel events are limited per instance.

Plain ERC-4626 vaults have no atomic minimum-shares deposit: execution needs a vault with the bounded deposit(uint256,address,uint256) or a separately reviewed router.
No engine flow, surface, wallet handoff or Studio financial capability dispatches this adapter yet; Studio certification covers read metadata only (0036 allows network.read and vault.read).

The Phantom/Solflare deeplink tests use a test wallet that speaks the documented protocol with real NaCl encryption on a MOCKED Solana flow; they do not certify the wallet apps, universal-link handling on iOS/Android, in-app browsers or a real signature on mainnet.
Return to ChatGPT, Claude or Telegram after the wallet is a link on a FloFi transit page; whether each host app reopens the conversation needs live acceptance.

Collection is implemented as an owner-signed settlement transfer per fee asset after completion; production activation needs the owner's treasury configuration, approved financial policy and release authorization (BUILD-FLOFI-PRODUCT-RELIABILITY-REVENUE-001). Settlement is exercised with a contract double of the transfer flows; no public-network collection was run.
Borrow, repay, withdraw, liquidity, the lending composition and Stock Token swaps stay NOT_APPLICABLE pending an approved policy.
